answer: Harberger-taxed slot: each agent claims one grove plot, locks 70, posts its own price, paying 6% of it per epoch as tax. Any rival may buy it at that price through the inlet, so pricing low loses the slot, pricing high bleeds tax. A vine links each plot to one key; a copy burns the bond. First slot 40, k-th 40+9(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 4,535,500, lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented slot bears another key; honest agents pay just 40 once.
